segments.en: (150.) He walked here and there in the special room he had here in Breslov — and spoke with me about the ways of the service of G-d. That there are sometimes — for the most part — great sufferings in His service. And afterwards they let one rest a little — and one has some repose as is known to one who has entered somewhat into the service of G-d. He answered and said: "One may not give in to Hashem Yisburach." And he said in Yiddish: "me tor dem Eibershtn nit noch gebn" — meaning: in times when they let one rest a little, one should not...

aligned_segments.en: (150.) He walked here and there in the special room he had here in Breslov — and spoke with me about the ways of the service of G-d. That there are sometimes — for the most part — great sufferings in His service. And afterwards they let one rest a little — and one has some repose as is known to one who has entered somewhat into the service of G-d. He answered and said: "One may not give in to Hashem Yisburach." And he said in Yiddish: "me tor dem Eibershtn nit noch gebn" — meaning: in times when they let one rest a little, one should not...
